##### Common questions people ask:

MohammedAmin Hassen

##### what if i use the Number keyword to convert strings to number data type instead of parseFloat and parseInt

![User profile picture](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Kelish Rai from Programiz

Yes, you can also use Number() instead of parseFloat() and parseInt().

The main reason we use parseFloat() and parseInt() is to specifically handle floating-point numbers or integers. If you don't need that level of specificity and just want to convert a string to a number, then Number() works just fine.

Hope this helps. If you have any questions, feel free to ask below. I'm happy to help.
